name: Euronews (English)
policyNote: robots.txt blocks GPTBot/CCBot but allows some AI retrieval agents; however the terms limit downloads to personal, non-commercial use and forbid exploiting content in any way without permission. Conservative default.

name: Global Voices
policyNote: Site licensed CC BY 3.0 unless otherwise stated (globalvoices.org/about/global-voices-attribution-policy); commercial use allowed with credit and link. Third-party photos/audio/video may differ. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries full text.

name: Mongabay
policyNote: Articles CC BY-ND 4.0 (news.mongabay.com/copyright/creative-commons); asks republishers not to sell material separately or republish behind paywalls. GFRN partner content is CC BY-NC-ND. Third-party photos excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries excerpts.

name: Agência Pública
policyNote: Reports distributed under CC BY-ND 4.0 (apublica.org/republique); own rules forbid reselling reports and cutting or editing them; newsletter columns excluded. robots.txt is empty. Feed carries full text.

name: European Commission Press Corner
policyNote: EU-owned content licensed CC BY 4.0 under Decision 2011/833/EU (commission.europa.eu/legal-notice_en); logos, trade marks and third-party works excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries short descriptions; press-corner pages are rendered client-side.

name: European Central Bank
policyNote: ECB site terms allow free use with the ECB cited as source; if included in sold documents, buyers must be told the information is free on ecb.europa.eu. Signed working papers excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed mixes press releases, speeches and interviews; no body text.

name: GOV.UK
policyNote: Content under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where stated (gov.uk/help/terms-conditions); commercial reuse allowed with attribution; logos and third-party material excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries summaries; high volume across departments.

name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
policyNote: Most CDC content is public domain (cdc.gov/other/agencymaterials.html); requires 'Source: CDC' attribution, a no-endorsement disclaimer and no change to substantive content; contractor, third-party and stock items excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents; edge blocks some user agents. The unparameterised feed returns its whole archive (1,800+ items since 2006); `?max=25` limits it to the latest items.

name: NOAA
policyNote: US federal government work, public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105; third-party images may differ. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Low-volume feed with summaries only.

name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
policyNote: sec.gov information is public and 'may be copied or further distributed ... without the SEC's permission' (sec.gov/about/privacy-information); seal and logos excluded. Fair Access policy: max 10 requests/second, declared User-Agent, no unclassified bots. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Feed carries summaries.

name: Federal Register
policyNote: US government publication, public domain. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents, but document HTML pages redirect automated clients to unblock.federalregister.gov; full text must be fetched from the API's raw_text_url/body_html_url. Feed carries titles only.

name: NASA
policyNote: Text is a US federal work, but NASA's media guidelines say AI outputs must not be attributed to NASA ('References like "according to NASA" ... are prohibited in AI products'), which conflicts with cited summaries. robots.txt allows all. Held at metadata only pending a decision.

name: The Conversation
policyNote: Articles CC BY-ND 4.0 but commercial use needs a paid licence and AI training is prohibited (republishing guidelines). robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude agents from /. Metadata only.

name: KFF Health News
policyNote: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; KFF states for-profit outlets may republish, but the licence is non-commercial and summarisation is not covered. Wire photos and 'All Rights Reserved' stories excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only until permission is confirmed.

name: The Texas Tribune
policyNote: Free republishing under house rules with no named CC licence ('Don't sell the story'); ToS grants only a revocable limited licence; partner stories excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Too vague for commercial processing; metadata only.

name: CalMatters
policyNote: Free republishing under house rules with no named CC licence; ToS forbids automated access and copying or reselling site resources. Wire photos excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only until permission is confirmed.

name: The 19th
policyNote: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; republishing rules say 'Do not sell or syndicate our content' and 'Do not scrape our website'. Photos excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: Grist
policyNote: Terms limit use to personal, noncommercial purposes and state RSS is 'for private, non-commercial use only'. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: Inside Climate News
policyNote: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 with prior permission required; forbids wholesale or automatic republishing. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: ProPublica
policyNote: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 US; 'You can't republish our material wholesale, or automatically'. Photos excluded. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: The Markup
policyNote: Terms allow one personal, noncommercial copy; other use needs written permission. Some articles carry a CC licence (variant not verified). robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: Rest of World
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude-Web from /. Republishing licence not verified. Metadata only.

name: The Kyiv Independent
policyNote: No open licence; content is offered through paid syndication and licensing. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: Scroll.in
policyNote: No open licence found (terms page not located, so unverified). robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Conservative default.

name: Daily Maverick
policyNote: Terms say users must not republish, reproduce or redistribute material. robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot and Google-Extended, but that is not a licence. Metadata only.

name: Rappler
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude agents from /. No open licence found. Metadata only.

name: GroundUp
policyNote: Articles under the GroundUp Republication Licence 1.0, which requires prior approval before republishing. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only until permission is confirmed.

name: Meduza
policyNote: Reported to use CC BY 4.0, but no licence statement was found on the site or in the feed. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only until the licence is verified.

name: Agência Brasil
policyNote: EBC states its content is Creative Commons and free to reproduce for non-commercial purposes; commercial use needs a licence (licenciamento@ebc.com.br). robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: UN News
policyNote: UN terms of use allow personal, non-commercial use only, with no right to redistribute or create derivative works. robots.txt does not restrict AI agents. Metadata only.

name: CBS News
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot from /, including the feed path; ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot and Google-Extended are not named. Paramount terms limit content to personal, non-commercial use and bar unauthorised scraping and data mining. Metadata only.

name: ABC News
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot and Google-Extended from /, including the feed path; ClaudeBot is not named. ABC's RSS page says headlines are offered 'to facilitate reading our stories via news aggregators'. Metadata only.

name: NBC News
policyNote: nbcnews.com robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude-User from /. The feed host feeds.nbcnews.com serves no robots.txt. NBCUniversal terms grant a personal-use licence only. Metadata only.

name: PBS News Hour
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot and CCBot from /, including the feed path; ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Google-Extended are not named. PBS terms of use have no RSS- or AI-specific clause. Metadata only.

name: The Economist
policyNote: Paywalled. robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude-User from /, including the feed path. Terms page returned 403 to automated clients and was not reviewed. Metadata only.

name: Sky News
policyNote: news.sky.com robots.txt disallows AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended) from /, allows user-initiated AI agents, and limits news aggregators to RSS. Feed host feeds.skynews.com allows */feed for all. Metadata only.

name: DER SPIEGEL International
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot and Claude-User from /, including the feed path. Impressum and robots.txt reserve commercial text and data mining under § 44b UrhG and prohibit automated access without permission. Low volume (a few items a week). Metadata only.

name: Politico Europe
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended and Claude-User from /, including /feed/. Terms allow personal, non-commercial use only and bar commercial exploitation of content. Metadata only.

name: CBC News
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, anthropic-ai and CCBot from /, including the feed path; ClaudeBot and Google-Extended are not named. The CBC RSS page invites integrating feeds into other interfaces and has no usage restriction. Metadata only.

name: ABC News (Australia)
policyNote: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot and Google-Extended from /, including the feed path. ABC terms of use returned 403 to automated clients and were not reviewed. Metadata only.
